text:
sanjay: morning — saw ~12% spot interruptions on gpu-pool-us-west-2 in the last 24h. thinking we should broaden instance-type mix and add a fast on-demand fallback for critical queues. thoughts?

marie: yes please. broadening sounds good but we need to be careful about perf variance across families. can we bin-pack by GPU family to avoid mixing h100 & g4 on the same node pool? :thinking_face:

alex: we did a short test with a multi-instance-type fleet in staging. ~8% lower cost but tail latency for small-batch realtime jobs went up ~6-7%. batching jobs were fine. tradeoff depends on SLA.

devon: proposal sketch: run multi-AZ mixed-instances ASG (or provider equivalent) with capacity-optimized spot + on-demand % above base, and an interruption handler that drains and requeues. example config snippet: 
```hcl
resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu_pool" {
  mixed_instances_policy {
    launch_template { /* ... */ }
    instances_distribution {
      on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity = 25
      spot_allocation_strategy = "capacity-optimized"
    }
  }
  instance_types = ["g5.48xlarge","p4d.24xlarge","g4dn.12xlarge"]
}
```
This gives us diversity but keeps some guaranteed on-demand buffer.

sanjay: +1 on the on-demand buffer. we should also add instance_type scoring in the scheduler so latency-sensitive pods prefer homogeneous nodes. simple affinity + binpack scoring should help.

marie: also a caution: different driver/kernel combos across families cause image/runtime drift. we need either a node-level driver manager or container images built for a superset. looking at nvidia-container-toolkit + module loader as an option.

alex: operational rule idea: if spot capacity for a pool drops below 60% of desired for >5m, controller flips routing to dedicated pool and scales on-demand. we measured failover time ~2-3m in testing.

sanjay: how do we surface per-instance-type interruption rates? can we query Prometheus?

devon: yes, metric we use: `sum(rate(spot_preemptions_total[1h])) by (instance_type, region)` and a derived `spot_utilization = running_spot / desired_replicas`. also add per-type cost-per-token estimate.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: alert created: #inc-642 "gpu-spot-interruptions-us-west-2" -> severity P2. escalation: eng-infra oncall.

marie: we should also run a 2-week canary that routes low-priority batch jobs into the mixed pool and measure end-to-end cost+latency. if stable, expand.

sanjay: ok i'll draft a runbook + canary plan and post tomorrow. key tasks: (1) add instance_type affinity + binpack scorer, (2) implement on-demand % in fleet config, (3) interruption handler + graceful drain, (4) driver compatibility checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:

alex: +1. If you want I can share the staging perf dashboard and config.

devon: I'll prepare the terraform snippet and the alert rule for spot_utilization threshold.

sanjay: awesome. tagging this thread for follow-up next week.
